2018 Q3.gq: Based on our current assumptions of the new GE agreement, we now expect our GE revenue to decline by 4% to 6% year-over-year compared to our prior outlook of the lower end of an 8% to 10% decline.

2019 Q1.gq: So from our perspective, kind of maintaining our outlook to where we were at the beginning of the year is where we want to be.

2020 Q1.bq: We saw broad momentum in our business, and revenues exceeded our expectations despite some late headwinds driven by COVID-19.
